sources.title: CRUSH maps
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: DAOS 交易容器：原子更新與批次提交成本
related.titleEn: DAOS transactional containers: atomic updates and commit batching
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：有容量卻無合法故障域的方案必須拒收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reject plans with enough bytes but no valid failure-domain placement.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「DAOS 交易容器：原子更新與批次提交成本」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付鍵值依賴圖、交易邊界、提交成本與重試規則。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct DAOS transactional containers: atomic updates and commit batching with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver key dependencies, transaction boundaries, commit costs and retry rules.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 把 120 TB 邏輯資料拆成四份，再補兩份 parity，記錄不含 metadata 的理想值。
為 100 紀錄逐項計四次更新和一次提交，保持 ms 單位。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Split 120 TB into four data shares and add two parity shares, excluding metadata.
For each of 100 records account for four updates and one commit in milliseconds.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Slurm Accounting：分配核心時間與實際 CPU 利用
related.titleEn: Slurm accounting: allocated core-time versus CPU use
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：有容量卻無合法故障域的方案必須拒收。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reject plans with enough bytes but no valid failure-domain placement.
related.difference: 以合成資料重建「Slurm Accounting：分配核心時間與實際 CPU 利用」，能分離架構事實、模型假設與驗收證據。完成：交付 accounting 欄位字典、分母核算與相同工作量的對照證據。
related.differenceEn: Reconstruct Slurm accounting: allocated core-time versus CPU use with synthetic data; distinguish architecture facts, model assumptions and acceptance evidence. Complete: Deliver accounting-field definitions, denominator audits and equal-workload evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 把 120 TB 邏輯資料拆成四份，再補兩份 parity，記錄不含 metadata 的理想值。
用八個CPU各300秒畫可用矩形，再填入960 CPU-s。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Split 120 TB into four data shares and add two parity shares, excluding metadata.
Draw eight CPUs over 300 seconds and fill 960 CPU-s of actual use.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
